articleTitle: Algorithm of measurement information processing for hardware and software complex capture and automatic tracking of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract: In this paper we developed the algorithm for the automatic tracking of unmanned aircraft for image sequence based on correlation filtering to improve the efficiency of conducting objective control and simulation in Matlab and C#. The measurement results showed good convergence of the theoretical and experimental data. The advantage of this approach is the possibility to use it in real-time through the application of fast direct and inverse Fourier transform; availability of the implementation in various environments for object-oriented programming such as Visual C#/C using the library of structures and algorithms EmguCV/OpenCV and the libraries of algorithms for fast discrete Fourier transform FFTWSharp/FFTW; the possibility of the approach implementing in the systems with reconfigurable integrated circuits based on programmable logic; “Field programmable gate array” (FPGA); the use of the adaptive approach in the program code design. For further improvement of the algorithm it is appropriate to work in the area of window tracking changes due to the deformation or removal of the object to reduce the computational cost.

articleTitle: Implementation of telemetrie on-line monitoring system of elastic torque of rolling mill line of shafting
abstract: The paper defines the main causes of impermissible dynamic loads in the shaft assemblies of a horizontal plate mill stand. It substantiates the development and commercialization of a stationary telemetry system for continuous control of the torque of the shaft assemblies at the 5,000 mm mill stand at Magnitogorsk Iron and Steel Works, OJSC. The authors determine the main system functions and list requirements to the equipment. They offer hardware for the measuring, transmission and visualization of signals proportional to the torque applied by springs. The peculiarities of the resistance strain gage arrangement and connection are under consideration. The paper describes the equipment designed for wireless power supply to a signal encoder and digital data transfer between a transmitter and receiver. The results of the system commissioning at the 5,000 mm mill are provided as well. The paper presents an example involving the installation of a telemetering ring and gage head for inductive supply and data capture. It shows a system interface view with the representative oscyllographs of torques on the shafts of the upper and lower spindles. This system proves its efficiency. Based on the results of a long-term monitoring, focus areas in the development of algorithms enabling control of the main electric drives are specified; they are aimed at the dynamic torques limiting in the shaft assemblies of the horizontal mill stand.

articleTitle: Data buffering in information-measuring system
abstract: A model of input data buffering in measuring systems is developed. The authors obtained the formulae to determine the following time intervals: between two successive transactions to signal source, two successive transactions to signal receiver, between transactions on data receiving and generation, between transactions on data generation and receiving. It is shown that an adequate model of the buffered systems functioning is a complex Markov process, each state of which is a 2-parallel Markov process describing the “competition” between transactions filling the buffer and the transactions emptying the buffer. The complex process was transformed into the ordinary Markov process, the states of which simulate the number of currently filled buffer cells. The ordinary process analysis permits to obtain a formula interlinking the failure probability, the buffer memory volume and the ratio between the mathematical expectations of the time necessary for buffer filling and emptying.

articleTitle: Potassium iodate purity determination by high precision coulometric titration: New measurement procedure implementation
abstract: A modified measurement procedure for the purity determination of high purity potassium iodate is described. The procedure consists of the coulometric standardization of sodium thiosulfate by generated iodine, stoichiometric interaction of standardized sodium thiosulfate with potassium iodate and the coulometric titration of excess sodium thiosulfate by generated iodine. In the proposed measurement procedure a previously unused method of simultaneous reagents adding (potassium iodate and sodium thiosulfate solution) into a coulometric cell is implemented. A relative expanded uncertainty for the potassium iodate purity determination 0.011% (k = 2) has been achieved.

articleTitle: Correction of dynamic errors of fiber-optic pressure sensor based on estimation of nonlinearity value of membrane stress-strain behavior and adaptive method
abstract: The article reviews the capabilities and particularities of the approach to the improvement of metrological characteristics of fiber-optic pressure sensors (FOPS) based on estimation of the nonlinearity value of the membrane stress-strain behavior and the adaptive method. It is shown that this method applied to the metrological characteristics allows for the measurement errors to be minimized. It is found that the suggested mathematical model provides for not only the main membrane characteristics such as sensitivity and stress distribution to be obtained but also the stresses' maximum values and zones of their concentrations to be determined. It is shown that, in case of FOPS being different by a significant non-linearity of the transformation function of “laser - feeding light guides - membrane reflector - branching-off light guides - photoconverter” unit, the algorithm of the adaptive correction method is appropriate to be included in the algorithms for photoconverter data processing.

articleTitle: Methods of estimation of electrical equipment condition based on integral diagnostic attribute
abstract: The authors highlight that stationary condition monitoring systems for high-voltage equipment is an essential prerequisite of the Smart-Grid implementation in the industrial electric networks. Diagnostic systems commissioning is relevant for network and electric furnace transformers of iron and steel works. The system operation performance is deteriorated because of lack of the methods intended for general estimation of cumulative diagnostic attributes. The authors formulate requirements to a general technical condition criterion and develop dependences for its calculation. They consider the provisions for electric equipment condition estimation based on integral diagnostic attributes. The process system condition is displayed as a line diagram based on non-equal informative parameters. The paper provides an example of these methods application for a general parameter reflecting condition of the electric furnace transformer based on monitoring key gases dissolved in oil. It offers significance factors and thresholds of the deteriorated and pre-emergency conditions for each information parameter. It provides normalized diagrams of humidity and concentration of gases dissolved in oil. The authors draw conclusions on the effect gas concentration has on the facility general technical conditions. Thus, the efficiency of the developed methods for the estimate of furnace transformer technical conditions based on integral diagnostic features is confirmed. These methods are recommended for condition analysis based on partial discharge monitoring. They may also be adopted for the diagnostics of electrical equipment in on-line monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Software and hardware complex for studying semiconductor devices at low, incl. cryogenic, temperatures
abstract: The authors gave reasons for preference of choice of hardware and software making possible to perform automatically the low-temperature research of electronic components (analog ICs, BiTs, JFets). The article considers measurement techniques, software features and an experimental setup that allow determining the main parameters of analog integrated circuits (IC), bipolar transistors (BiT) and junction field effect transistors (JFET) at low temperatures up to the liquid nitrogen temperature. Agilent Visual Engineering Environment software was used to control of the measuring instruments. In the developed subroutine PIP_V7-91_ISCC_Mk2.vee, designed for simultaneous measurement of the current consumption of 4 blocks using voltmeters B7-91 and a programmable power source, several UserObjects are used: ExcelFileHeader, MultimeterSet, MeasurementCycle, DataToCells. For measuring of CVCs by the E7-25 immittance meter, the developed system uses the subroutine e7-25_Mk2.vee, which stores the measurement results in an Excel file. To control of the measuring instruments, we used also “LIDER” software and an additional program that converts the measurement results into csd-format, due to which they can be imported and processed by the graphic postprocessor of the widely used OrCAD®Capture software.

articleTitle: Method for internal heat source identification in a rod based on indirect temperature measurements
abstract: The article is devoted to the measurement challenge associated with identification of the unknown time-dependent internal heat source when measuring is possible only at the one end of a rod. The required source function in this problem must be determined from the results of indirect temperature measurements. To solve this problem, we propose the approach that allows us to describe the explicit dependence of the unknown internal heat source on the initial data via the Volterra equation of the first kind. The method for the term source function calculation based on the regularization technique is also developed. The efficiency of the proposed approach and accuracy of the numerical solutions were evaluated by means of a computational experiment.

articleTitle: Recursive matrix pencil method
abstract: The main concern for many applications (for example, for Coriolis Mass Flow Meter signal processing in two-phase flow conditions) is to track several domain poles of signals with minimum delay. The Matrix Pencil method (MPM) estimates the signal as a sum of complex exponentials. Creating a computationally efficient moving MPM implementation is of a high interest. The most computationally expensive step of the classical MPM is to calculate the singular value decomposition (SVD) of a matrix composed from the signal samples. When a new data point enters the data window, this matrix changes only slightly, and it is reasonable to find its SVD not directly but using the SVD of the old matrix and a low-rank SVD modification procedure. In this paper a well-known SVD modification procedure is adapted for MPM and a recursive version of MPM is proposed. The amended method is validated by numerical examples and is faster than the original suggesting it may be feasible to track signal parameters on-line. The errors accumulating over time due to the recursive calculation require the recursive MPM to be restarted periodically.

Author Keywords: coriolis mass flow meter signal processing

articleTitle: Forming model for dynamic measurement of cities' readiness to implement smart city technologies
abstract: This article is devoted to the formation of the dynamic measurement model of the cities' readiness to implement Smart City technologies. The hypothesis of the study is the assumption of the simulation modeling possibility in terms of determining the degree of cities' readiness for the introduction of Smart City technologies. The aim of the research is to develop a model of dynamic measurement of cities' readiness to implement Smart City technologies based on the author's approach to simulation modeling. To achieve this goal, it is necessary to fulfill the following set of tasks: to consider the theoretical aspects of Smart City technologies in the current realities of development of a new paradigm for economic development; to offer an analytical model of dynamic measurement of the cities' readiness to implement Smart City technologies; to create a simulation model of the dynamic measurement of cities' readiness to implement Smart City technologies on the example of some municipal entities. The novelty of the scientific article is the author's approach to the consideration of the issue of cities' readiness for the introduction of Smart City technologies. The study is quite interesting from the point of view of applying imitation technologies in the digital economic environment. In the future, this research topic can be elaborated and supplemented as a part of the development of strategic programs for the introduction of Smart City technologies into the economy of the country.

articleTitle: Angular installation options errors correction for three-component vector-measuring transducers with accelerometer at calibration phase
abstract: The method for an algorithmic correction of errors in determination of the angle parameters of three-component vector-measuring transducers installation in the body of a measuring device is presented. The factors influencing the metrological characteristics of three-component vector-measuring transducers with accelerometers are reviewed. The methods to reduce the errors defined by the constants characterizing the particular 3D positioning of measuring transducers in the device body are defined. The method to refine the constants' numerical values determined at the calibration stage due to their parametric optimization in accordance with the scientifically proven criteria is proposed.

articleTitle: Implementation methods of self-calibration in intelligent magnetostrictive transformers of linear displacements
abstract: In this article the authors analyze the relevance of intelligent sensors use. The review and classification of the functions of intelligent sensors and systems is given. Structural diagrams for an intelligent measuring system of magnetostrictive linear displacement sensors are considered. There are two ways to implement the self-calibration function, with mathematical control points and active control points.

articleTitle: Neural network models for diagnostics of complex technical objects state by example of electrochemical treatment process
abstract: The work is devoted to solving the problem of monitoring and diagnostics of the complex technical and technological objects state by data-based models application. As an example of these models use, the process of electrochemical dimensional processing of high-strength materials was considered. The models of electrochemical processing based on neural networks are developed. The option for introduction of the developed models in the control system of electrochemical machining machines with the use of the Fault Detection and Identification method is proposed. The experimental results have shown that the developed models can reproduce the real process of electrochemical treatment and may be used for the tasks of diagnostics of the state of technological electrochemical processing.

articleTitle: Parallelization of numerical algorithm for optimum dynamic measurement problem solution
abstract: One of the important things in the dynamic measurements theory is the task of dynamically distorted signal restoration. The existing algorithms demand a bigger amount of machine time. In the project the numerical algorithm of the optimum dynamic measurement problem solution with the use of parallelization and linear splines is presented. A distinctive feature of the algorithm is that one was able to use the parallelization procedure by means of consideration of the optimum dynamic measurement problem as a mixed optimum control problem. Previously, for the solution of the optimum dynamic measurement the problems of rigid and optimum control were used. We emphasize that the functionality of the quality of the mixed optimum dynamic measurement problem preserves the basic principle of dynamically distorted signal restoration - achievement of proximity between virtual and real observations. The algorithm is adapted for effective usage on the computing system with parallel architecture or the multiprocessor computing system. Parallelization as well as the use of linear splines at one of the algorithm stages will allow to reduce the amount of machine time necessary for calculations.

Author Keywords: numerical algorithm of an objective of optimum dynamic measurement

articleTitle: Method for modeling accuracy measuring in evaluation of sustainability of information structure security system in terms of negative impacts
abstract: The article considers existing simulation methods implemented under the conditions of the ensured uniformity and required accuracy of the results in the evaluation of the stability of functioning of the information structure security system in the conditions of negative influences. The evaluation of the sustainability of an information structure security system in terms of negative impacts is initially based on the development of the information interaction model for the information structures elements relating to the security systems and negative impacts. The authors used a set-theoretic approach allowing not only to describe the characteristics of building elements of the examined structures but also to carry out the process formalization for the security complex functioning models in the form of the construction of discrete (matrix-vector) models with different classifications of threats sets. Assuming the continuity of the time parameters of the functioning process of the information structures' security systems as information systems in terms of negative impacts, it is possible to provide integrated (dynamic) models built with the help of differential equations and describing the state of its elements, which allows, in its turn, assessment of the limits of sustainable management processes occurring during the interaction of these sets.

articleTitle: Method for measuring of latent indicators of continuous sets of original information data
abstract: This paper proposes an estimation method for the latent variable Rasch model based on the method of least squares which allows a continuous data set using. The research suggests the application of original approaches within the method for the solution of some applied problems. The authors explain how to use it for task assignment and work organization, decision-making under certainty and the securities portfolio formation. The conducted computational experiments showed that the model based on the method of least squares is characterized by high statistical accuracy and can be used to calculate the latent variable estimates. At the same time, this model has a much wider range of practical applications than the classical Rasch model. In compliance with the Rasch model based on the method of least squares the authors proposed a new approach to the work organization, methods of decision making under certainty, models of expert estimation by the method of hierarchies analysis, the algorithm of securities portfolio formation. The model is based on the method of least squares can also be used to estimate the latent indicators during the evaluation of quality, efficiency, and other areas of theoretical and practical studies. In particular, there are works in which the described model is used in education, expert evaluation as well as for the assessment of software quality and personnel competence.

articleTitle: Gaussian signals simulation using biconnected Markov chain
abstract: The problems of constructing Gaussian signals models with a given three-dimensional probability density on the basis of the biconnected Markov chain are considered. The article presents a Markov model shaping technique; to describe it, the use of three-dimensional diagrams for joint and transition probabilities matrices as well as their contour lines is proposed. The properties of the biconnected Markov model and the effect of the elements of the correlation coefficients matrix in the three-dimensional Gaussian random process on them are considered. It is shown that the considered model allows taking into account the fine probability structure of the Gaussian random process. The results of simulation modeling are presented. The possibilities to construct the biconnected Markov model from the experimental realization of a random process are considered. The technique for estimating the elements of the transition probabilities matrix is proposed. On the basis of the biconnected Markov model, a universal digital simulator of normal random processes with given probabilistic properties and elements of a matrix of correlation coefficients can be realized to measure the statistical characteristics of electronic equipment. It is based on the probability distribution function of a simulated process. On the same basis, a programmable pseudo-random number sensor useful for the problems of the simulation modeling of Gaussian random processes is implemented.

articleTitle: Method of analog-to-digital conversion of current signals conveyed by sensor based on multi-valued adder
abstract: The article considers an unconventional way of analog-to-digital conversion (ADC) of current signals conveyed by the sensors based on the application of the properties of the linear analog current adder (ACA). The authors give the main equations, the ACA circuitry as well as the results of its computer simulation which show that the k-valued code is output current signals of the ADC of the considered subclass. The results of the ACA synthesis confirming the efficiency of the generalization version considered in the article and the structural identity of the circuit solutions of the adders for different valuedness of logic are presented. It is shown that, providing the valuedness increases, the number of the simultaneously added numbers increases as well.

articleTitle: Estimation of errors of aircraft air parameters measurements based on satellite navigation system data
abstract: The article considers the algorithm of estimation of systematic measurements of aircraft air parameters in flight, based on the application of methods of the theory of identification of dynamic systems. The main complexity of the problem under consideration is caused by the dependence of airspeed, angles of attack and slide on wind speed, since these signals, that is, airspeed, angles of attack and slide, are related to the speed of the aircraft relative to air. The main idea of the algorithm is that three projections of wind speed at the point of location of the aircraft are evaluated simultaneously with parameters characterizing the systematic errors in measuring airspeed and aerodynamic angles. The estimation is obtained through parametric identification. The simulation results, obtained on the flight simulator and confirming the efficiency of the algorithm and high accuracy of the estimates of systematic errors, are presented.

Author Keywords: estimation of the systematic measurement errors

articleTitle: Comparison of set-valued dynamical system state estimates
abstract: The article deals with set-valued state estimation for linear dynamical systems. Set-valued estimation consists of a construction of feasible sets, which are guaranteed to contain all state vectors. The known set-valued state estimation algorithms include performing set operations like Minkowski sum and set intersection, those are computationally complex. Feasible set approximation with canonical forms, i.e. ellipsoids, parallelotopes, zonotopes, is used to reduce computational complexity although it causes loss of estimation accuracy. The algorithm of feasible set polyhedral approximation without performing set operations is suggested. The algorithm produces set-valued estimate as a polyhedra of any shape. The algorithm consists of solving a row of linear programming problems and can be easily programmed. The article shows the comparison of set-valued estimates constructed with polyhedral approximation algorithm with ellipsoidal estimates and confidence areas based on Kalman filter estimates.

articleTitle: Robust photogrammetric method to estimate geometric parameters of spatial objects with axial symmetry
abstract: The article deals with a robust photogrammetric method to measure the geometric parameters of large scale objects with axial symmetry. The method is based on measuring the 3D-coordinates of the centers of circular retroreflective targets placed on the object in planes perpendicular to the axis of symmetry with the minimum moment of inertia. There has been developed a two-stage outlier filtering algorithm and its software implementation.

Author Keywords: spatial large objects with rotational symmetry

articleTitle: Research of recognition algorithm for sheet metal marking
abstract: The problem of automation of the product traceability processes within the technological process has now become of major importance. The most common traceability method is based on optical identification implemented by various markings application to the product surface. Such markings can contain a wide variety of information that allows one to determine the parameters of the raw materials, the manufacturer, the technological operations already performed and much more. In this case, the degree of readability of such markings can be used by a human operator as a recognition criterion. The paper presents an algorithm for optical character recognition to determine the marking of steel sheets used in the pipe and tube rolling industry. This algorithm was used for the development of the system of technical vision (STV) and implemented in the C# programming language with the use of specialized Emgu CV libraries. The main difficulties encountered in the recognition of marking elements as well as the methods for their elimination are considered in the paper.

articleTitle: Dynamic measurement error correction on the basis of recurrent neural network
abstract: Neural networks along with expert adaptive regulators and systems with associative memory form the basis of intelligent technologies for information management and processing [1], [2]. This paper introduces an algorithm for the dynamic measurement error correction based on a neural network (NN) inverse model of a measuring transducer (MT). It uses the reduction principle in the compensating filter for proper operation with high order MTs and noises filtering based on a NN model of an IIR filter. In this regard, the development of dynamic models of measuring systems based on recurrent NN and algorithms for dynamic measurement data processing using NN technologies is one of the promising directions for the development of the modern measuring equipment intellectualization. Successful solution to this task will significantly improve the metrological characteristics and efficiency of existing MTs without significant material costs due to deep mathematical processing of the measurement results.

articleTitle: Principal component analysis using self-organized neural network
abstract: The method principal component (PCA) allows to allocate from a matrix of these several objects with a large amount of signs only 1-3 vectors containing 90-95% of information. Usually measuring problem of assessment of these main components is solved by the iterative NIPALS procedure or the algebraic SVD procedure, however both of these methods often give ambiguous estimates. For the purpose of elimination of ambiguity, alternative approach to measurement main component on the basis of the self-adjusted neural network is offered. Convergence analysis shows that the single neuron governed by the self-organized learning rule, adaptively extracts the first principal component of the input signal. Considered two options of the stabilization of Hebbian algorithm: a) with the weight normalization dividing by Euclid's RMS according to the equation; b) with the weight cancellation according to the equation. Parameters of the speed adjustment vary considerably for these algorithms, however, the summary values of weights compare within the four decimal digits.

articleTitle: Simulation of wave characteristics of evaporating liquid film
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of instability of a liquid film flowing over a solid surface under the gravity action. The mathematical model of the condition of the free surface taking into account the heterogeneity of surface tension and shear stress is presented. The results of computational experiments on the wave characteristics of liquid film and areas of instability under the influence of shear stress and insoluble surfactants are presented. The calculated wave characteristics of the liquid film flow (wave number, phase velocity) with a maximum increment value are provided. It is found that the minimum value of the liquid film phase velocity corresponds to the flow regime with a maximum increment value. Areas of instabilities in two-phase flow of liquid films in the evaporation process are identified.

articleTitle: Analysis of planar interdigitated electrode system used in impedance measurements of liquid materials
abstract: The planar interdigitated electrode system used in a electrochemical cell for impedance measurement is considered. To estimate the influence of microelectrode parameters on the impedance of the electrochemical cell, the analytical approach is proposed. This approach includes analytical modeling for determining the potential distribution in the interdigitated microelectrode system and the usage of an equivalent electrical circuit for considering the electrochemical processes in the cell. Based on this approach, the analysis of the planar interdigitated electrode system used in the electrochemical cell with the small height is performed. The influence of the finger width and spacing of the interdigitated electrodes on the character of the impedance diagram and on the real and imaginary parts of the impedance is established.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of oscillatory regimes in oregonator
abstract: A five-stage Field-Noyes-Köros model of the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction and the corresponding mathematical model of the oregonator is presented. A system of equations for the oregonator steady states is derived. The oregonator steady states are calculated for different values of the stoichiometric coefficient. The steady state was investigated according to the experimental data of the model's authors. The solutions obtained correspond to the physical meaning of the model. Modeling of the chemically active system oscillatory regime is performed. Oscillation regimes exist for different values of the stoichiometric coefficient. The time of the system's output to the oscillatory regime is determined. The amplitudes of the oscillations are in agreement with the experimental data of the model authors.

articleTitle: Estimation of events flow generated with ergodic semi-Markov processes
abstract: The paper considers the events flow generated with the ergodic semi-Markov processes which are rather adequate formalisms to describe informational-measuring systems under the Von Neumann computer control. Pearson's regression and correlation criteria for estimation of the proximity events flow to the Poisson flow are investigated. It is shown that the procedure used for such criteria calculation has a high computational complexity. The authors newly obtained the formulae for a parametric criterion and the criterion based on the waiting function properties. The authors demonstrated that the waiting function criterion has the least computational complexity. The waiting function criterion applicability is verified with the Monte-Carlo method.

articleTitle: Weibull distribution's parameters in electrical insulation reliability assessment
abstract: Many parametric models are used for equally distributed random variables (without taking into account the time dependence of the onset of the system event from covariates). The Weibull's distribution is considered to be practically justified for statistical analysis in technical systems. However, there is a problem of distribution parameters finding. The accuracy of distribution parameters's estimates depends on the accuracy of the estimates of the hypothetical distribution parameters and on the proximity of the hypothetical distribution to the true distribution. There are different methods and approaches to unknown parameters finding. There are probabilistic and statistical methods. All of them give an approximate solution to the problem. We consider various methods for finding out the parameters of the Weibull's distribution and suggest a method to replace the distribution function of a given distribution by its probabilistic estimate in this article. The article provides the examples of unknown parameters finding by means of the maximum likelihood methods, substitution of the distribution function, specialized mathematical program as well as and their comparative estimation.

articleTitle: Calibration of sensors for technological production
abstract: The paper considers application of methods for the uniform approximation of functions to find the polynomials of the approximation of sensors' inverse conversion functions. It suggests an iteration algorithm to implement the weighted uniform approximation of the dependency of the sensor's exit code on the ambient temperature. The experimental data were used to demonstrate the efficiency of the offered method for sensor calibration temperatures determining. The offered method allows one to determine an optimal set of temperatures for sensor calibration by the number and the resulting approximation error. The obtained reduction of the calibration time to the minimum possible value providing the required sensor accuracy will allow one to reduce the prime cost of sensors which is important for sensor manufacturers.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of steganalysis algorithms correlation estimation with computational complexity considering
abstract: The article is devoted to the construction of a mathematical model and the algorithm for reducing a set of staganalytical correlated methods taking into account the computational complexity of the problem. The basic steganographic methods for the images spatial domain are described. Known steganalytical algorithms for the spatial domain are reviewed. It is shown that a significant number of steganalytical algorithms do not lead to results improvement but slows down the analysis. The necessity of choosing an optimal set of steganalytical algorithms is explaned. The too much power of the set of steganalytical algorithm combinations is shown. The disadvantages of the variance analysis in solving this task are pointed. The theoretical basis for constructing a mathematical model using Fisher and Laplace theorems is presented. The mathematical model of reduction of a set of correlated steganalytical algorithms is given. The peculiarity of the model is the estimation of the computational complexity of the task. The algorithm allowing adding and removing algorithms from consideration without additional calculations is developed.

articleTitle: Scalable algorithm for non-stationary linear programming problems solving
abstract: The paper describes a new scalable algorithm called NSLP for high-dimension, non-stationary linear programming problem solving on the modern cluster computing systems. The algorithm consists of two phases: Quest and Targeting. The Quest phase calculates a solution for the system of inequalities defining the constraint system of the linear programming problem under the condition of the input data dynamic changes. To do this, it uses the apparatus of Fejer maps. The Targeting phase forms a special system of points having the shape of the n-dimensional axisymmetric cross. The cross moves in the n-dimensional space in such a way that the solution of the linear programming problem is permanently in the ε-vicinity of the cross central point.

articleTitle: Examples and analysis of interaction of two-dimensional Verhulst-Pearl model decisions
abstract: The article is based on the use of the concept of discrete iterative Verhulst-Pearl transformation. First, the non-standard application of this mapping in the financial sphere is shown. Then in the work a two-dimensional model of antagonistic and dependent two sets was studied. The number of each of them depends on the opposite. With the help of computer programs, new graphical schemes of these processes were constructed. The phenomena of cycle origin, the interaction of attractors and the emergence of chaos are investigated. The system has from 1 to 4 tree-like roots. An exact “map” of these regions has been obtained. A complete bifurcation diagram of the two-dimensional Verhulst-Perl map is obtained. The authors called this image a fractal cabbage. In the section we get the well-known Feigenbaum tree.

articleTitle: Multiphysical models of mechatronic systems for conducting measurements by natural model methodology
abstract: The aim of this paper is to develop the theoretical basis of mechatronic systems construction using the principal components projection method for conducting natural model measurements of mechatronic systems parameters. It is difficult to name a technical sphere where mechatronic systems aren't applied. They can be found in many household appliances, communication devices, they make an integral part of electrical machinery, many devices of industrial automation, control equipment and protection of various electrical installations. To conduct natural model measurements, we need models connecting various parameters of mechatronic systems between each other.

articleTitle: Strapdown inertial navigation system calibration
abstract: The paper aims at improving the accuracy of the calibration of strapdown inertial navigation systems (SINS). The calibration is carried out using a 2-axial motion simulator. A new computational method is investigated for the calibration coefficients of the error models of accelerometers and gyroscopes of the strapdown inertial navigation system based on the errors of the system output signals. The modified navigation algorithms of the 3-channel strapdown inertial navigation system are used. The algorithms of the system orientation and navigation are generated using the kinematic Poisson's equations and the basic equation of the inertial navigation in the quaternion form. Damping links are introduced into the algorithms; they have been built based on the errors in the linear velocity computing and errors of the orientation angles computed as a difference between the system data and the motion simulator data. As a result, the vector and quaternion dependences are obtained to calculate the signals of the accelerometers and gyroscopes; they are used to calculate the instrumental errors and calibration coefficients of the error models. The increased calibration accuracy of the system is achieved by the reduction of the signals' noisiness of the accelerometers and gyroscopes after they have been processed with the modified algorithms and as a result of eliminating the symmetry requirement of the calibration coefficients in the opposite positions of the simulator as well as a result of the instrumental errors consideration for the motion simulator.

articleTitle: Evaluation of system parameters for eddy-current non-destructive testing
abstract: The paper offers mathematical models and software for electromagnetic calculations in conducting plate with flaws (cuts). It solves the problem of the influence of one or more straight line intersecting in one point of flaws on eddy currents and electromotive force (EF) induced in a coil with current. The coil is located above the nonmagnetic infinite plate orthogonally to the lines of flaws. Under these conditions, when the plate is geometrically thin and can be replaced by a conducting surface, the problem is solved analytically. The calculation data illustrated by the graphs of the dependence of the EF on the proximity of the flaws when the frequency of the current and the height of the coil are varied show that the contribution of the flaws to the magnetic reaction is practically attenuated at a distance exceeding the sum of the linear dimension of the coil and its height.

articleTitle: Optimal solutions to indoor temperature control problems for district heating systems in short supply conditions
abstract: In the modern-day automated district heating systems a lot of importance is attached to functional reliability of the heat generating units and pipeline networks to ensure uninterrupted supply of heat medium of expected quality and quantity. This is usually achieved by redundancy of both generating equipment and heat medium transport pipelines. However, such redundancy can not be provided for all systems as a consequence of technical or economic constraints. Therefore, during heating system accidents, it starts operating in the so called short supply condition. In this case, there is a need to redistribute heating energy between consumers, for example, according to their social significance. At the same time, in the general case, distribution among different-ranking consumers is disproportional with maximum possible maintenance of required temperature range for more significant consumers. Meanwhile it is required to distribute energy to among equal-ranking consumers in a proportionate manner. Distribution of this kind can be properly performed only on the basis of thermotechnical calculation. Such calculation can be promptly performed and implemented using automated district heating systems, whose control should be based on modeling and simulation. The article considers algorithms required for implementation of automation systems operating to the principle of buildings indoor temperature maintenance in short supply conditions of a heating system.

articleTitle: Identification modeling of inertial sensors' parameters of strapdown inertial navigation systems
abstract: The paper aims at improving the accuracy of the strapdown inertial navigation systems (SINS). The calibration is carried out using a 2-axial motion simulator. The influence of motion simulator instrumental errors is investigated. They effect the errors in the determination of calibration coefficients for SINS accelerometers and gyroscopes. Fiber-optic gyroscopes are used in SINS. The scale factor errors, biases and errors of misalignment axes are accepted as the parameters of inertial sensors error models. SINS is installed on the motion simulator platform. The deviation of the platform rotation axis from a local vertical as well as the platform plane non-orthogonality to the rotation axis are accepted as the motion simulator instrumental errors. A method for determination of the motion simulator instrumental errors, the models of accelerometers errors and fiber-optic gyroscopes errors along with algorithms for calculating calibration coefficients taking into account the motion simulator instrumental errors are described in the paper. The determination of inertial sensors calibration coefficients is carried out under the motion simulator static conditions. As a result of the conducted research, dependences for the determination of inertial sensors calibration coefficients were obtained taking into account the motion simulator instrumental errors.

articleTitle: Approximate solution to inverse problem of solid state physics
abstract: The paper considers an important practical problem of the crystal phonon spectrum determining by the heat capacity dependent on the temperature. The problem reduces to an integral equation of the first kind solvable by the regularizing algorithm. This algorithm involves finite-dimensional approximation of the original problem and allows reducing the problem to a system of linear algebraic equations by use of the Tikhonov regularization method. The approximate solution accuracy accounting for the error of finite-dimensional problem approximation has been estimated. It is shown that no significant transformation for the physical model of the problem is required to apply the numerical methods. This allows considering a priori information effectively while solving the problem.

Author Keywords: fredholm integral equation of the first kind

articleTitle: Inaccurate measurements processing for guaranteed estimation in dynamical system stabilization problem
abstract: The paper describes and compares some approaches to the use of measurement results for control using the classical feedback principle. The application of a linear control law based on the state vector estimates obtained with the use of the Kalman filter and the minimax filter is described. There are methods for control quality improving by means of the preliminary processing of measurements and another approach to the synthesis of the local-optimal control algorithm based on the prediction of the state vector estimation. A comparative analysis of the described control algorithms is carried out using a numerical example.

articleTitle: Information processing on the computer system state using probabilistic automata
abstract: The paper deals with the processing of information on the state of a computer system using probabilistic automata. An intelligent system model for the detection and classification of malicious software is proposed which compares a set of features that are characteristic for different classes of viruses with multiple states of the machine. The analysis process is reduced to the modeling of the automaton operation taking into account the probability of transition from state to state where each step is recalculated depending on the environment reaction. The received research results allow one to draw a conclusion about the possibility of using the offered system for harmful software detection.

articleTitle: Metrological monitoring of power consumption metering systems at manufacturing plant
abstract: Industrial power consumption cost-benefit analysis requires reliable data on the electric power amounts distributed between manufacturing departments and process units. Furthermore, reliable power consumption data provide the base for fiscal cost clearing at electric power markets. These data are supplied by the electric power measuring systems (counters) the failure of which results in the gross errors of power audit. This fact predetermines the relevance of metrological monitoring measuring systems improvement during operation. The proposed methods are based on the detection of a wild power imbalance value and further analysis of each counter impact. It is proposed to apply the criteria of empirical distribution at formalized imbalance analysis: the mean standard deviation and the coefficient of pair correlation between the imbalance and the load of each of the substation connections. Based on the analysis of power imbalance graphs, the method of purposeful tracking of the dynamics indicators for these criteria according to the configuration of moving average graphs is substantiated. An example of the monitoring reliability of electric power metering data at the connections of the 10 kV portion of the metallurgical plant substation is considered. The results of the developed method implementation at daily data reliability verification by the automated metering system are presented. The effective detection of faulty measuring systems is confirmed.

articleTitle: Testing image synthesis for skanners verification
abstract: The article considers the approach to scanners testing. It is shown that a scanner includes two main channels: channel of photoelectric conversion and channel of measurement of objects spatial co-ordinates. Despite the fact that both channels include virtually the same elements, channel parameters testing should be separated. For this purpose, a special structure of a two-dimensional reference signal is proposed where the fields intended for different scanner parameters testing are spatially separated. Information losses during transformation of the document into a digital form are linked with the scanner characteristics. The reference signal parts forming and working out of the methods for measuring information processing to test the grayscale transmitting ability, resolution and aberrations level are considered.

articleTitle: Method of production defects identification of high-potential positioning systems
abstract: The article describes a method for identifying the production defects of high-precision positioning systems using principal component analysis. This approach is necessary to determine the presence and a production defect type of the end product. The basis of the developed approach is the use of the principal components projection method and the classification method of k-means. The program was developed in the package of Labview implementing the proposed method. Experimental studies using the dynamic characteristics of the magnetization proportional solenoid hydraulic drives were carried out. The proposed method performance and effectiveness were proved.

articleTitle: Measurement of gold concentration in stream: Device development and testing
abstract: At present, there are no devices for operational control of valuable components in the gold-mining industry. The proposed device for the automatic control of gold concentration measurement is based on the anion-selective electrode analysis method which has several advantages: rapidity, compactness and ability to be easily integrated into an automated process control system. The ion-selective electrode-sensor is the basis of the measuring device. Various sensor designs and devices based on them are given in the article. Two devices were developed for laboratory and industrial experiments. The test results of the automatic control device of [Au(CN)2]~ in alkaline cyanide solutions are shown. The tests were conducted in order to evaluate the accuracy of measurement with the proposed device in comparison with the atomic absorption method of measurement. The results were assessed. The measuring devices found out the measurement error. During the tests, while there were large quantities of the impurity components, the static characteristics of ion-selective electrodes were also obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation of conversion function for vortex sonic flowmeter using monte-carlo method
abstract: The article is dedicated to the investigation of adequacy of a new conversion function model for a vortex sonic flowmeter, proposed by the authors using the Monte-Carlo method. The Monte Carlo method is a numerical one used for solving mathematical problems by modeling random variables. During the study, the parameters of the data simulating the measuring information of the vortex sonic flowmeters were determined. Based on the data, a new model of the conversion function was simulated. During the investigation, the adequacy of the conversion function model proposed by the authors for the vortex sonic flowmeter was confirmed in the region of low flow rates.

articleTitle: Strategy of surfaces measuring on the basis of minimization of control points number
abstract: The accuracy and productivity of measurement performed with the help of coordinate measuring machines depend not only on their technical characteristics but also on the strategy used to select the number, location of the points and the sequence of their circumvention on the surface. The article proposes a new strategy for the determination of the number and location of control points on surfaces based on the statistical simulation Monte Carlo. This approach allows us to obtain the interval estimates of measurement error for the workpieces' batches. The real data based modeling has shown the number and location of control points significantly affects the magnitude of the error in the measurement and analysis of flatness, cylindricality and sphericity. As the number of measurements decreases, the probability of measurement type II errors increases. The authors give recommendations for choosing a rational number of control points on surfaces such as flatness, cylinder, sphere.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of linear phased array from near-field data using iterative regularization
abstract: This paper considers a method for detecting faulty elements in a linear phased array by means of set near-field probes. Using the asymptotic correspondence for two- and three-dimensional problems of the antenna theory leads to simpler mathematical models for the vertical dipoles array. A numerical study of mathematical models is based on the iterative regularization of the ill-posed problem of reconstructing current distribution to reliably locate the defective elements in the array. It is proved that the proposed diagnostic method provides for the high accuracy and stability of the mathematical models of phased array even when random errors in data measurement are sufficient. The results fully confirm the proposed technique efficiency.

articleTitle: On one type of liesegang operator
abstract: Oxyhydrate colloid gel parameters measurements and estimations are performed in this paper. Measured parameters are sizes of oxyhydrate clusters, concentrations, polarization vector values and some others. Measurements were performed with simple methods as measuring optical density, electric current value and microscopic observation. Accuracy of these observations is typical for these well-known methods - ±1nA for electric current, ±5% for optical density, ±5% for microscopic observations. But colloid gel parameters are not available for direct measurements. That is why this paper deal most of all with mathematical apparatus and the assumptions about the behavior of the gel. That is why accuracy of the results depends essentially on correctness of these assumptions. We consider the obtained exactness of the result is rather low, ±90% or even less. Nevertheless, even such an inaccurate result is of some achievement.

Author Keywords: dynamic of rare metals oxyhydrate colloid

articleTitle: Numerical solution of dynamic measurement problem by volterra polynomials
abstract: The paper demonstrates the possibility of the Newton-Kantorovich method application to numerically solve the Volterra polynomial integral equations of the first kind. The specific features of the studied nonlinear equations make it possible to specify an initial approximation for the iteration process represented by solving the respective Volterra linear equations of the first kind. The method convergence is illustrated on the model equations of the second and third degrees. The paper presents the specific features of the numerically solved studied equations with a fixed length of a mantissa in the machine representation of a floating-point number. The practical part of the research is concerned with the application of the developed algorithms for the measurement of a blade lean of a horizontal-axis wind turbine with a synchronous generator.

articleTitle: Computer modeling and measurement of devastating impact characteristics of snow avalanches
abstract: The paper provides the mathematical model describing the movement of different kinds of avalanche snow mass and its interaction with obstacles based on the modified method of particle dynamics. Further, the authors introduce their algorithm to calculate avalanche impact on buildings and structures; this algorithm underlies a computer program that allows you to set the basic parameters of a building, snowpack, terrain slope and calculate the indicators of displacement and overturning of the building and magnitude of the energy impact. The article confirms the adequacy of the model by the example of avalanches in Longyearbyen. It is shown that the average error in determination of 10 indicators of the displacement of buildings makes up 4.3 %. The model allows one not only to reproduce the displacement of homes but also to restore a detailed picture of the mechanical impact of avalanches. Thus, the model can be used to predict the damaging effects of snow avalanches on the infrastructure.

articleTitle: Vibrodiagnostics of compressor valves via empirical mode decomposition method
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical model of a piston compressor which is a part of an oxygen gas generator. Taking into account the structural parameters of the compressor, as well as the suction and pressurization valves, such model allows one to obtain the dynamics of the pressure amplitude under the compressor's piston with the vibration velocity and vibration acceleration that are transmitted in the form of mechanical affections to the equipment (such mechanical affections can be observed at the corresponding sensors use). We also investigate the use of the Empirical Mode Decomposition algorithm for determination of the compressor's model parameters that determine the defect evolution.

articleTitle: On the selection and application of the associated feature when evaluating the form and location of surfaces and axes of workpieces
abstract: The use of various associated features in evaluating the form and location of surfaces and axes of engineering components leads to significant differences in the values of the deviations obtained. Analysis of this influence, advantages and disadvantages of individual types of associated elements, as well as a criterion for their selection is considered in this paper.

articleTitle: Markov model based mathematical representation of radio signals
abstract: The possibilities of implementation of Markov model of radio signals with various types of modulation at the output of the radio transmitter are considered. Markov models of Gaussian random processes are studied. The properties of the obtained models are analyzed. For their graphic description, three-dimensional representations of matrices of joint and transition probabilities are proposed. The properties of matrices and the effect of random process parameters on them are considered. Based on experimental implementations, transient probability matrices of AM-FM radio signals, as well as FM with minimum frequency shift and Gaussian-filtered minimum-shift keying (GMSK) are formed; their inherent difference is shown. The stationary probabilistic characteristics of these signals are considered. It is shown that the statistical properties of radio signals can be quite complex and Markov models are suitable for their reflection. Markov models can be used in the formation of universal algorithms for automatic classification of radio signals from the observed realizations. The types of modulation, radio signal parameters or the nature of transmitted messages can be the classification feature. Theoretical or experimental Markov model can be used to implement digital simulators of pseudo-random signals with given probabilistic properties. They are intended for measuring the statistical characteristics of radio signal processing equipment and in programs for its simulation modeling.

articleTitle: Design and metrological assurance of tracking amplitude resolver-to-digital converter based on contactless magnetic sensor
abstract: The paper deals with the structural synthesis of a tracking mechatronic converter on the basis of up-to-date element base. The urgency of the research is substantiated by the analytical review of modern information technologies for controlling the mechatronic systems and converters. The electromechanical subsystem of the mechatronic system contains a contactless permanent-magnet machine as an energy converter. Being a part of the information subsystem, a sine-cosine magnetic-field sensor is used as a measuring transducer for the common dataware of working mechanism displacement control. The total error of the mechatronic converter measurement channel has been calculated. It has been proven that modern discoveries in the field of sinus-cosine magnetic encoders generating make it possible to increase the efficiency and precision of gearless electro-mechatronic converters.

articleTitle: Estimation of characteristics of multifunctional air data probe for air data system
abstract: The development of the air data systems is actually divided into two directions: integration of air data systems of classical architecture with other systems (in particular, inertial ones) to improve the accuracy of altitude and speed parameters measuring and the transition from classical architecture to multifunctional air data probes combining both air data measurement and altitude and speed parameters calculation. The second direction is a more complex task from the point of view of the requirements specified to the converters of the primary information (air pressure probes and pressure sensors), computing devices. The estimation of the required accuracy of absolute pressure sensors is performed. In addition, possible ways to improve the measurement accuracy of the aerodynamic angles are discussed, in particular, the algorithms for processing of the measured pressures field and the assessment of the aerodynamic angles values.

articleTitle: Approach to fuzziness measuring
abstract: In this paper an approach to information quantitative measuring is offered. This information is given as a fuzzy number. It is a particular case of the fuzzy set which is defined by a membership function. It should be noted that this function is determined on the basis of some segment on the set of real numbers. Therefore, a problem changes into construction of the fuzzy number membership function. Quasiconcave membership functions of fuzzy numbers are most frequently used in economic and social problems. For this type of fuzzy numbers this paper provides an algorithm of the fuzzy numbers' membership function construction according to the expert's opinion. The algorithm is based on a segment sequential localization procedure. The fuzzy number membership function is defined by means of this segment using the expert opinion. This procedure is similar to the procedure of extremum seeking of the quasiconcave function through the instrumentality of the sequential measurements of its values. Two ways of such localization have been examined.

articleTitle: Tool and algorithmic diagnostic devices of operability of actuation mechanisms of automated control systems
abstract: In case of the decision of the task of design of automated control systems for crucial objects, a minimum possible level of risks at uncontrollable interference in the processes of functioning of these systems, and also minimization of negative consequences from a similar interference in the course of its operation are required. In connection with this, on the basis of the system theory of conflict management and the matrix approach to the description of the structure of complex organizational systems, the authors solved the measurement problem of establishing a correspondence between the physical properties of the object and the characteristics of its mathematical model with the aim of diagnosing the health of actuators and detecting internal conflicts between them. In this article we propose an algorithm that allows one to solve private probabilistic and statistical measurement to identify conflicts in the operation of systems of this class, both at the stage of their development and in the course of operation. In addition, the paper proposed a set of dynamic and statistical models solving private measuring tasks in the process of diagnostic decisions making on the health component of the Executive device in the automated control system. The process of diagnostic solutions making is described by a Petri net and Markov and allows one to propose a methodology to determine the functionality of the diagnostic solutions, to clarify the level of operability of the actuation mechanisms and to receive the diagnostic inference as well as to estimate operability risks of the actuation mechanisms taking into account risk factors and operability of the actuation mechanisms components. The list of the associated failure of an automated control system is also offered. The program or hardware implementation of this algorithm will allow one to create a universal remedy for diagnosing and monitoring of the automated control system integrity.

articleTitle: Testing quality assurance of single crystals and stock on their base
abstract: The application of single crystals in acousto-, opto-, micro - and nanoelectronics defines strict requirements to crystals and crystal elements as well as the need for certification of these products. The use of single crystals in acousto-, opto-, micro - and nanoelectronics defines strict requirements both to crystals and crystal elements, and it concurrently defines the need for the certification of these products. However, there are difficulties with the metrological support of measurement to assess the quality of the crystals and stock on their base. There are virtually no accredited test laboratories responsible for testing these materials. Many methods for the measurement of important parameters of single crystal materials are not certified. There is a shortage of industrially produced standard samples for such measurements. All these factors create a problem in terms of reliable measurements making and the certification of crystal elements. Thus, the Testing laboratory (TL) “Single Crystals and Stock on their base” (ILMZ) was found in the NUST “MISiS” in 2001. The purpose of the laboratory activity is the assessment of the quality of the optical, acoustic and semiconductor single crystals and stock on their base as well as the certification and scientific research of the testing objects and development work on the creation of new test beds, measurement methods and certified establishment reference samples.

Author Keywords: system for ensuring the uniformity of measurements

articleTitle: Spectrophotometric methods and their capabilities to study material optical parameters
abstract: We conducted a comprehensive study using the spectrophotometric complex “Cary 5000” with the accessories “DRA” and “UMA”. We used this complex to obtain accurate, high-precision results for different material types, especially for single crystal optical materials in the range of the wave-length from 250 to 3500 nm in polarized light with different types of polarization and non-polarized light, in the wide range of incidence angles of light. We developed and certified measurement techniques to measure optical parameters for different sample types: solids with rough and polished surfaces, powders, liquids and single crystals. We developed reference enterprise standard samples. The results obtained on different materials have practical significance.

articleTitle: Architecture of industrial close-range photogrammetric system with multi-functional coded targets
abstract: This paper describes an industrial close-range photogrammetric system that is being developed by the authors. We describe the system's architecture based on an iterative scheme, which allows using fast heuristic point matching algorithms with the follow-up result verification. We also describe the design of our multi-functional coded targets that allow using those algorithms. Besides, this design allows the exact and robust determination of cameras pose and orientation in low-light scenes. We propose to use these coded targets as the scale reference in some fields of application, thus eliminating the necessity to use high priced precision scale bar. We also propose a technique for calibration of the base points of coded targets that increases measurement accuracy. We estimated the accuracy of our proposed approach both by simulation modelling and by real experiment. The implementation of the proposed multi-functional coded targets can significantly reduce the system's price and increase its usability in several application fields.

articleTitle: Usage of dual-parametric neural networks for measuring instruments calibration
abstract: This study is focused on the application of the forecast results obtained with the help of a dual-parametric neural network for measuring instruments calibration within a limited range. In this report describing our study we intend to give a theoretical overview of the previous research on the subject. We also consider the learning algorithms for interval neural networks with hidden layer weights assigned in either real or interval values. There is a description of a dual-parametric neural network as a neural network type and the examination of learning algorithms for the respective interval neural network models. We consider the calibration methodology and the calculation procedure to determine the applicability of forecasts based on the use of interval neural networks. There is a presentation of the results of numeric experiments aimed at the dosimeter readings predicting by means of the dual-parametric neuron network. Finally, we analyze the results obtained while drawing conclusions regarding the applicability of this approach for measuring instruments calibration.

articleTitle: Status of problem of creating metrological complexes for photonics purposes
abstract: The paper deals with the creation of a universal metrological complex meant for the calibration of various photometric and radiometric equipment as well as distant and collimated optical radiation sources within the range of 0.25-1.25 micron. The main lines of the research are the extension of the range of registerable radiation intensities, primarily in the area of weak radiations, automation of measurements, as well as creation of a reconfigurable complex architecture and an optical scheme which allow one to carry out many various studies both in the sphere of space instrument engineering and biophotonics, water, air quality and toxic substances control in food and pharmaceutical products. The authors present analytical dependencies used for the calibration of collimated and distant radiation sources based on the comparison method.

articleTitle: Modeling of safety system for technical diagnostics of measuring channels under conditions of information introduction and measuring systems
abstract: The problem of the technical diagnostics of measuring channels under the conditions of information introduction and measurement systems in terms of complex safety is considered. The purpose of the study is to build models for creation and evaluation of the effectiveness of the systems that ensure the safety of the technical diagnostics of measuring channels based on a systematic approach to the accounting of the risk impact. To determine the necessary set of security measures, a model for creating a security system was built. To take into account the degree of risk influence on security, a model for assessment of the security system effectiveness is constructed. The requirements for the creation and evaluation of the safety system are fulfilled by involving representatives of all measuring channels engaged in the process of technical diagnostics in the expert group work. Using the example of the Chelyabinsk thermal power station-2 which operates various information and measuring systems the authors describe the process of models construction for creation and evaluation of the effectiveness of the systems that ensure the safety of measuring channels technical diagnostics. The developed algorithm and the design program of the system providing technical diagnostics safety for measuring channels at work with various information-measuring systems allowed one to improve the efficiency of safe work measures maintained at the Chelyabinsk thermal power station-2.

articleTitle: Computer modeling and measurement of characteristics of water masses distribution to forecast probability of area flooding
abstract: The method based on the solution of a problem of any gap disintegration is offered. It is based on the consecutive solution of the classical equations of small water on the equal plane by the Godunov's method taking into account the influence of current vertical heterogeneity when calculating streams through borders of the cells adjoining step borders. The accounting of vertical heterogeneity is provided with the use of the Riemann task solution on a step on the basis of the small water quasitwo-layer model. The developed differential scheme provides the uniformity of the decision implementation in the areas having a difficult geometry of the spreading surface as well as an equal bottom, profitability during the work with big settlement areas on space, the accounting of forward kinetic energy dissipation at a step and a possibility of adding various drains, mass sources, friction. In the developed model, the space extent in each of two spatial X, Y directions makes up to 16,000 cells of a grid (the total of cells makes 256,000,000 which provides high specification in the area representation. At the same time, four neighboring areas from which water inflows or which make water return possible have each knot of a grid. All this allows one to suggest a mathematical model application for the calculation of water masses dynamics and the algorithms for effective placement and assessment of the suitability of a territorial water system for fire fighting equipment. Furthermore, it allows for the development of a complex of the programs and computing means providing a possibility to forecast flooding of the territories.

articleTitle: Problems of non-intrusive measurements of fluid flow parameters in pipelines
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the existing methods and solutions of non-intrusive methods for flow parameters measurement. The literature sources with various types of measurement instruments used to measure the flow parameters were studied and reviewed. The theoretical materials on non-intrusive methods and device implementation examples are presented. The method for combination of the measurement of flow parameters to improve accuracy and reliability is proposed.

articleTitle: Problems and methods for optimal design of experiments and processing of their results for identification of heating networks thermal-hydraulic models
abstract: The effective solution of operation problems, adjustment and dispatching management of thermal networks can be obtained applying modern mathematical modeling methods, calculation and optimization. However, lack of reliable information about their actual parameters and characteristics substantially depreciates virtually all sets of these methods. The majority of thermal networks parameters and characteristics can be received by means of tests or on the basis of the identification problem solution. Depending on the required parameters, the tests of thermal networks, can be divided into hydraulic and thermal ones. Branch techniques for hydraulic and thermal tests conduct have a number of shortcomings. Besides, separately conducted hydraulic and thermal tests involve additional material, labor and time expenditures. The paper proposes the plan of joint optimum thermal-hydraulic tests with the purpose of simultaneous obtaining of both hydraulic and thermal characteristics. For thermal-hydraulic tests the authors suggest using the active identification methodology developed in Melentiev Energy Systems Institute of Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences.

Author Keywords: model of thermal and hydraulic conditions

articleTitle: On approximate solution of non-linear inverse problem: (the quasi-reversibility method)
abstract: An inverse boundary value problem is considered for a non-linear parabolic equation. Two-sided estimates are obtained for the norms of non-linear operator values in terms of the norms of values of the corresponding linear operator. As a consequence, two-sided estimates are established for the modulus of continuity of a nonlinear inverse problem in terms of the modulus of continuity of the corresponding linear problem. The quasi-reversibility method is used to construct stable approximate solutions for the nonlinear inverse problem. A sharp error estimate is obtained for the arbitrary boundary conditions method on a uniform regularization class.

Author Keywords: modulus of continuity of the inverse operator

articleTitle: Method for definition of losses of active electric energy in transformer on the basis of monitoring of its surfaces temperature and device for its implementation
abstract: The article considers a possibility to apply a method for the estimation of electric losses in the transformer based on the control of temperature on its surface without a current measurement in windings. For the accounts the differential equation of a heat account of the transformer is used. The complexity of its direct application in view of the necessity to use the physical sizes depending on the transformer design data is shown. As a result, the expressions are obtained allowing to spend a loss evaluation for uniform and non-uniform modes of operation of the transformer on the basis of the decision of a differential equation for heat account with the definition of separate parameters of the transformer on the basis of its rating data. The experimental research of the expression for a non-uniform mode of operation of the transformer with the application of exact gauges has shown a sufficient applicable error of definition of losses on the temperature measurements, 1 %, not exceeding the average one. The authors describe a developed device for the temperature monitoring of windings and the transformer core and the environment with a possibility of wireless data transmission on the personal computer. The application of the developed device as the device for gathering the primary information for the account of losses of active electric energy in the transformers allocated in the form of heat in windings and magnetic system is considered. The experimental research of the work of the developed device, with application of exact gauges, has shown a relative error of measurement of the temperature, 1.14 %, not exceeding the average one for 1,600 gaugings. The results of experimental measurements executed by means of the developed device on the physical model “transformer-loading” are obtained at various modes of the transformer operation. The received results testify to the possibility of application of the developed device to measure the temperature of the core, winding and environment at a uniform and non-uniform production schedule with a further use of the measured data for the account of losses of the active electric power according to the way offered in article.

articleTitle: New algorithms for calculation of tolerances, selection of measurable currents and diagnostics
abstract: This paper proposes a new effective algorithmic basis for solving the problem of choosing the permissible deviations of the parameters of the elements, choosing the measured currents and diagnostics of the electrical device elements. The algorithms developed by the authors are based on the new modification of the Gaussian elimination method to solve the systems of linear algebraic equations. One of the advantages of this modification is a significant reduction in computing costs for solving the problems to analyze the operating modes of the electrical devices and their topology.
