The algorithms for the synthesis of electrical devices are developed on the basis of this modification. The application of the proposed algorithms is described in choosing the permissible deviations of the parameters of the device elements that provide the given limitations on the changes in the electrical regimes when determining the branches of electrical circuits in which current sensors are located that provide monitoring of all device currents, also in the rationale of the choice of the measured currents and voltages used to estimate changes in the parameters of the elements in order to diagnose them.

articleTitle: Method of measurement of charging decompensation at explosive plasma formation with computer information processing
abstract: The authors conducted a theoretical and pilot research of the physical phenomenon of a charging decompensation in the course of explosive formation and plasma warming up. This physical phenomenon cannot be described within relativistic electrodynamics. Its existence is predicted by hyper continual electrodynamics. It relies on the hyper continual ideas of space and time within which transition between inertial reference systems can be described by the level Lorentz transformations among which the fundamental part is assigned to the Galilei's transformations. Hyper continual electrodynamics has three basic laws being its cornerstone. The first basic law action is an immediate cause of emergence of the studied phenomenon. It expresses the dependence of the charge electric field strength on the speed of its movement. At plasma warming up the total negative charge of free electrons grows quicker than a total positive charge of ions. As a result, for a short time there is no compensated negative charge which becomes available to observation due to the arrangement of a suitable experimental installation. This research allowed us to obtain a method for measurement of a charging decompensation at explosive plasma formation. This measurement method is new as it allowed one to find out a new physical phenomenon impossible to be revealed with other existing measurement methods. Besides, the results of computer data processing of the pilot studies' outcomes are given.

articleTitle: Estimation of air data probe characteristics
abstract: This paper is dedicated to one of the promising directions in the development of aircraft air data systems that provide information about the altitude and airspeed parameters. The issues of the required air data measurement error as well as of further conversion of the measured air pressure by the pressure sensors are considered. In connection with the trend of eliminating of movable vane aerodynamic angles sensors, the paper dwells upon the rise of developments in the field of multifunctional air data probes which provide information not only about the total and static air pressure, but also about the aerodynamic angles of attack and slip. This paper describes the main sources of altitude and speed parameters measurement error and the ways to reduce such measurement error, mainly due to combined calibration of the air pressure probes and pressure sensors.

articleTitle: Data measurement smoothing in the guaranteed estimation algorithm for dynamical systems control
abstract: The present article delves into the problems of linear dynamical system state estimation and optimal control under uncertainty. Two approaches to filtering, Kalman filtering and the guaranteed estimation are compared. It has been shown that comparison requires correspondence between stochastic and deterministic mathematical models describing uncertain quantities. The optimal control solution is found. It ensures the result with the worst possible value of the cost function over all uncertain factors. A numerical example is given for the linear second order system. For the case of a time-varying dynamical system it has been demonstrated that the point estimate obtained by the guaranteed approach can have dynamics that is quite different from the dynamical behavior of the observed system. The smoothing algorithm for the point estimate dynamics is proposed.

articleTitle: Preface
abstract: Presents the introductory welcome message from the conference proceedings. May include the conference officers' congratulations to all involved with the conference event and publication of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Author index
abstract: Presents an index of the authors whose articles are published in the conference proceedings record.

abstract: Conference proceedings front matter may contain various advertisements, welcome messages, committee or program information, and other miscellaneous conference information. This may in some cases also include the cover art, table of contents, copyright statements, title-page or half title-pages, blank pages, venue maps or other general information relating to the conference that was part of the original conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Content
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: metrological ensuring of measuring instruments and measuring systems; methods and algorithms for digital processing of measurement information; new methods and tools of measurement; dynamic measurements; and new measurement technology in the industry.
